text: Eating well, staying active, and getting enough rest are the cornerstones of a healthy lifestyle. A balanced diet, rich in fruits, vegetables, and whole grains, gives your body the energy it needs, while regular exercise strengthens your heart and muscles. However, physical health is only part of the picture. Protecting your mental health is equally important, whether through mindfulness, hobbies, or simply talking to friends. Finally, make time for a proper work-life balance. Overworking leads to stress and poor sleep, so set clear boundaries and prioritize your downtime. Remember, small, consistent choices—not perfection—create lasting wellness.
